PACKMASTER-RUIN.title: Ruin
PACKMASTER-RUIN.description: The next time a creature with [gold]Ruin[/gold] takes unblocked attack damage, they lose HP equal to their [gold]Ruin[/gold] for each buff and debuff they have.
PACKMASTER-OBLIVION.title: Oblivion
PACKMASTER-OBLIVION.description: Orb: When evoked, applies [gold]Ruin[/gold] to the enemy with the most HP. Increases [gold]Ruin[/gold] applied whenever you discard a card.
PACKMASTER-MANIFEST.title: Manifest
PACKMASTER-MANIFEST.description: Gain an Orb slot then channel the listed Orb.
PACKMASTER-INSCRIBED.title: Inscribed
PACKMASTER-INSCRIBED.description: When played, activate the passive of your next Orb.
PACKMASTER-INFEST.title: Infest
PACKMASTER-INFEST.description: At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, shuffle it into your draw pile and put an infestation counter on it.
PACKMASTER-AGGRESSION.title: Aggression
PACKMASTER-AGGRESSION.description: In this stance, your Attacks deal [blue]25%[/blue] more damage. Upon exiting this [gold]Stance[/gold], gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
PACKMASTER-INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration
PACKMASTER-INSPIRATION.description: Inspiration increases the damage and [gold]Block[/gold] of the next card played by a percentage. [blue]Stacks[/blue] [blue]additively[/blue].
PACKMASTER-BASIC.title: Basic
PACKMASTER-BASIC.description: [gold]Basic[/gold] cards are the cards that you find in decks at the start of the run. They have the same border as Common cards but cannot be obtained through normal means.
PACKMASTER-CRITICAL_HIT.title: Critical Hit
PACKMASTER-PICKUP.title: Pickup
PACKMASTER-PICKUP.description: Effect triggers when you obtain this card.
PACKMASTER-FROSTBITE.title: Frostbite
PACKMASTER-FROSTBITE.description:
At the start of its turn, a creature with [gold]Frostbite[/gold] loses HP and its [gold]Frostbite[/gold] is halved.
Whenever a creature with [gold]Frostbite[/gold] receives attack damage, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
PACKMASTER-DICE.title: Dice
PACKMASTER-DICE.description: Dice increase the damage and [gold]Block[/gold] of the next card you play that deals damage or [gold]Blocks[/gold].
PACKMASTER-REROLL.title: Reroll
PACKMASTER-REROLL.description: [gold]Dice[/gold] are not used up when you play this card.
PACKMASTER-JAIL.title: Jail
PACKMASTER-JAIL.description: You cannot play Attacks or take damage this turn.
PACKMASTER-CHANCE.title: Chance
PACKMASTER-CHANCE.description: Chance cards are played when drawn, and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] when played.
PACKMASTER-ADVANTAGE.title: Advantage
PACKMASTER-ADVANTAGE.description: Roll [gold]Dice[/gold] an additional number of times and take the highest value of the rolls.
PACKMASTER-SHARPEN.title: Sharpen
PACKMASTER-SHARPEN.description: Raises the damage dealt by all existing [gold]Claws[/gold].
PACKMASTER-WANDERBOT.title: Wanderbot
PACKMASTER-WANDERBOT.description: Orb: Deals damage to the frontmost enemy. Draws a card when evoked.
PACKMASTER-MEG_ATHEREAL.title: MEGAthereal
PACKMASTER-MEG_ATHEREAL.description: Exhausts at the end of the turn, no matter where it is.
PACKMASTER-ODD.title: Odd
PACKMASTER-ODD.description: Additional effect if you played an odd number of cards this turn (including this).
PACKMASTER-EVEN.title: Even
PACKMASTER-EVEN.description: Additional effect if you played an even number of cards this turn (including this).
PACKMASTER-SYNERGY.title: Synergy
PACKMASTER-SYNERGY.description: Additional effect if you have cards from [blue]2[/blue] other packs in your hand.
PACKMASTER-DISCOVER.title: Discover
PACKMASTER-DISCOVER.description: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random cards matching the criteria.
PACKMASTER-HOARD.title: Hoard
PACKMASTER-HOARD.description:
When played, if this card's cost is greater than 0 and lower than it's Hoard:
Reduce Hoard by the card's cost and ignore all other card effects.
Return the card to your hand.
The card [gold]Retains[/gold] this turn.
PACKMASTER-DISTORTION.title: Distortion
PACKMASTER-DISTORTION.description: Creatures with [gold]Distortion[/gold] lose HP whenever a card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], then lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Distortion[/gold].
PACKMASTER-PENANCE.title: Penance
PACKMASTER-PENANCE.description:
When a creature obtains [blue]8[/blue] Penance, it loses [blue]20[/blue] HP and loses [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Penance[/gold].
HP loss from [gold]Penance[/gold] is increased by [blue]10[/blue] this combat.
PACKMASTER-CONFESSION.title: Confession
PACKMASTER-CONFESSION.description:
Whenever you take damage or lose HP, deal damage equal to your [gold]Confession[/gold] to ALL enemies.
If it isn't your turn, reduce [gold]Confession[/gold] by half.
PACKMASTER-LIGHT.title: Light
PACKMASTER-LIGHT.description:
[gold]Orb[/gold] - [gold]Passive[/gold]: At the end of your turn gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Confession[/gold].
[gold]Evoke[/gold]: Gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Confession[/gold].
PACKMASTER-ECHO.title: Echo
PACKMASTER-ECHO.description: Add an unmodified copy of this card with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to your hand.
PACKMASTER-FIRST.title: First
PACKMASTER-FIRST.description: Additional effect if this is the first card played this turn.
PACKMASTER-GEM.title: Gem
PACKMASTER-GEM.description: At [gold]Rest Sites[/gold], you may spend [blue]25[/blue] Gold to socket a [gold]Gem[/gold] as a free action, permanently [gold]Modifying[/gold] a card that costs [blue]1[/blue] or more in your deck with 'this [gold]Gem's[/gold] effects'.
PACKMASTER-FALLOUT.title: Fallout
PACKMASTER-FALLOUT.description: Whenever you play a Power, ALL creatures with Fallout take damage.
PACKMASTER-FLOW.title: Flow
PACKMASTER-FLOW.description: When you Flow, you may discard any number of cards. Draw half that many at the start of your next turn.
PACKMASTER-BOUNTY.title: Bounty
PACKMASTER-BOUNTY.description: Normal Enemy: [blue]15[/blue] gold. Elite Enemy: [blue]40[/blue] gold. Boss: [blue]100[/blue] gold.
PACKMASTER-SLOW.title: Slow
PACKMASTER-SLOW.description: Slowed creatures take [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from Attacks for each card played this turn.
PACKMASTER-MODIFY.title: Modify
PACKMASTER-MODIFY.description: Alter a card for the rest of combat. Modified cards cannot be modified again until the combat ends.
PACKMASTER-ABSORB.title: Absorb
PACKMASTER-ABSORB.description: Exhaust [blue]1[/blue] card. When this card is exhausted, add all cards it absorbed to your hand.
PACKMASTER-AMPLIFY.title: Amplify
PACKMASTER-AMPLIFY.description: If you have enough {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} pay the additional cost to activate the effect.
PACKMASTER-CHARGE_UP.title: Charge Up
PACKMASTER-CHARGE_UP.description: At [blue]6[/blue] or more stacks, double the damage of the next Attack and lose [blue]6[/blue] stacks.
PACKMASTER-FLURRY.title: Flurry
PACKMASTER-FLURRY.description: Specified effect triggers every time you play a card this turn.
PACKMASTER-HUNTED.title: Hunted
PACKMASTER-HUNTED.description: Takes [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from attacks for each stack of Hunted on them. When applied, all other hunted enemies are no longer hunted, and other enemies take [blue]10%[/blue] less damage from attacks for each stack. Reduces by [blue]1[/blue] each turn.
PACKMASTER-NOT_HUNTED.title: Not Hunted
PACKMASTER-NOT_HUNTED.description: Takes [blue]10%[/blue] less damage from attacks for each stack. Reduces by [blue]1[/blue] each turn. When the hunted enemy dies, remove this.
PACKMASTER-ENRAGED.title: Enraged
PACKMASTER-ENRAGED.description: At the end of the turn that no enemy intends to attack you, gain [blue]2[/blue] Strength.
PACKMASTER-GLASS_ARMOR.title: Glass Armor
PACKMASTER-GLASS_ARMOR.description: At the end of the turn, gain Block. When taking unblocked attack damage, remove this.
PACKMASTER-PLATED_ARMOR.title: Plated Armor
PACKMASTER-PLATED_ARMOR.description: At the end of the turn, gain Block. When taking unblocked attack damage, reduce by 1.
PACKMASTER-NONLETHAL.title: Nonlethal
PACKMASTER-NONLETHAL.description: Non-lethal damage will leave targets at 1 HP.
PACKMASTER-CROQUETTE.title: Croquette
PACKMASTER-CROQUETTE.description: A [gold]Retained[/gold] [blue]0[/blue] cost consumable tokens that provides a resource.
PACKMASTER-DIFFERENT_COLOR.title: Different Color
PACKMASTER-DIFFERENT_COLOR.description: Any color other than your character's normal card color. Different Packmaster Packs are not different colors.
PACKMASTER-OCCULT.title: Occult
PACKMASTER-OCCULT.description: [gold]Occult[/gold] cards can be played disregarding any conditions for playability. Cards played this way are [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
PACKMASTER-LOCKING.title: Locking
PACKMASTER-LOCKED.title: Locked
PACKMASTER-DUPLICATION.title: Duplication
PACKMASTER-DUPLICATION.description: Your next X cards are played twice.
PACKMASTER-ON_FIRE.title: On Fire
PACKMASTER-ON_FIRE.description: Play an additional time for each [gold]Fire Counter[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. Increase [gold]Fire Counter[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue] at the end of your turn while in your hand.
PACKMASTER-ADDICTION.title: Addiction
PACKMASTER-ADDICTION.description: After a number of turns, add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Despairs[/gold] to your hand and lose [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
PACKMASTER-EVOLVE.title: Evolve
PACKMASTER-EVOLVE.description: Evolving cards can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] up to [blue]3[/blue] times. They are [gold]Upgraded[/gold] this combat whenever the listed condition is met while the card is in your hand and gain bonus effects when fully [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
PACKMASTER-REND.title: Rend
PACKMASTER-REND.description: Receives more damage from attacks equal to Rend. Reduced by half at end of round.
PACKMASTER-RIPPABLE.title: Rippable
PACKMASTER-RIPPABLE.description: Right click this card to separate its effect from its cost and make both halves [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
PACKMASTER-ART_CARD.title: Art Card
PACKMASTER-ART_CARD.description: The art half of a [gold]ripped[/gold] card. It does nothing and always [gold]exhausts[/gold].
PACKMASTER-TEXT_CARD.title: Text Card
PACKMASTER-TEXT_CARD.description: The text half of a [gold]ripped[/gold] card. It always [gold]exhausts[/gold].
PACKMASTER-UNNATE.title: Unnate
PACKMASTER-UNNATE.description: Starts each combat at the bottom of your draw pile.
PACKMASTER-IGNITE.title: Ignite
PACKMASTER-IGNITE.description: Ignited creatures lose [blue]1[/blue] HP per stack at the start of their turn.
PACKMASTER-SWARM_OF_BEES.title: Swarm Of Bees
PACKMASTER-SWARM_OF_BEES.description: Orb: Deals damage to ALL enemies.
PACKMASTER-RAINBOW_LOUSE.title: Rainbow Louse
PACKMASTER-RAINBOW_LOUSE.description: Orb: Draw 1 card at the start of your turn. When [gold]Evoked[/gold], draw 2 cards.
PACKMASTER-PANDA.title: Panda
PACKMASTER-PANDA.description: Orb: Deals damage to a random enemy at the end of your turn.
PACKMASTER-WOLF.title: Wolf
PACKMASTER-WOLF.description: Orb: Deals damage to the enemy with the least HP. Damage is increased by the number of orbs that are [gold]Channeled[/gold]. When [gold]Evoked[/gold], gain an Orb slot.
PACKMASTER-PORCUPINE.title: Porcupine
PACKMASTER-LEPRECHAUN.title: Leprechaun
PACKMASTER-LEPRECHAUN.description: Orb: Rolls [gold]Dice[/gold]. When [gold]Evoked[/gold], applies [gold]Jinx[/gold] to ALL enemies.
PACKMASTER-JINX.title: Jinx
PACKMASTER-JINX.description: Jinxed enemies lose HP whenever they receive a debuff.
PACKMASTER-FIRE_SPIRIT.title: Fire Spirit
PACKMASTER-FIRE_SPIRIT.description: Orb: Apply [gold]Ignite[/gold] to ALL enemies. Gain [gold]Focus[/gold] when evoked.
PACKMASTER-TRANSMUTE.title: Transmute
PACKMASTER-TRANSMUTE.description: Transforms a card in combat into any card of the same rarity available through current card rewards. The new card deals [blue]1[/blue] more damage and gains [blue]1[/blue] more [gold]Block[/gold] for the rest of combat. This effect stacks.
PACKMASTER-MUTABLE.title: Mutable
PACKMASTER-MUTABLE.description: When a card is [gold]Transmuted[/gold], any [gold]Mutable[/gold] effect is passed on to the next card for the rest of combat.
PACKMASTER-ASCEND.title: Ascend
PACKMASTER-ASCEND.description: On Ascending, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}, draw [blue]2[/blue] cards and gain [blue]10[/blue] Strength that turn.
PACKMASTER-CASTS_WHEN_DRAWN.title: Casts When Drawn
PACKMASTER-CASTS_WHEN_DRAWN.description: When drawn or put into your hand, activate this card's effects on a random target. (This does not trigger on play effects such as Beat of Death.)
PACKMASTER-WEAPON.title: Weapon
PACKMASTER-WEAPON.description:
Whenever you play an attack card, one Durability of your rightmost Weapon is used and card's damage is increased by Weapon's Attack.
Orb slots are created and destroyed automatically.
PACKMASTER-REAPER_S_MARK.title: Reaper's Mark
PACKMASTER-REAPER_S_MARK.description: Whenever [blue]3[/blue] stacks are applied, they are removed and the creature loses HP equal to [blue]40%[/blue] of its missing HP.
